name: Workable
description: Workable lets agents look up jobs, candidates, and pipeline stages, and read employee and time-off records in the signed-in account. The signed-in user's Workable permissions limit what the agent can see and do.

prompts.text: List our open jobs and how many candidates are in each stage.
Summarize the candidates in the interview stage for the backend engineer job.
Who on the team is on time off next week?

apps.name: Workable
apps.description: Job, candidate, and HR record access, over Workable's MCP server with browser sign-in.
